overall: The AG found the Board violated the Open Meeting Law by discussing two anticipated employee contracts not listed on its April 14 agenda, but found no violation in members leaving the room.

allegations.summary: Board discussed employee contract renewals at its April 14 meeting though the topic was not listed on that agenda.
allegations.key_passage: Accordingly, the Board violated the Open Meeting Law by discussing the contracts.

allegations.summary: Two members allegedly left the April 14 meeting without adjourning the open session, raising concern about deliberation out of public view.
allegations.key_passage: Here, we find that while the Board members did leave the room to retrieve relevant documents, there is no evidence that any deliberation took place outside of public view.

remedy: Review the Open Meeting Law Guide and certify to the AG's office within 30 days that all Board members have reviewed the Guide and the determination.
remedy_passage: We order the Board to review the Open Meeting Law Guide available on the Attorney General's website and to certify to our office within thirty (30) days of this decision that all Board members have reviewed the Guide and this determination.
